content.text:
I'd take the third one, but I'm not very sure about it, and none of them speaks to me.

**What I decided**
- All three drawings show the same table with the same four funds and the same fees. They only differ in how they show that "עד 120%" part.
- I chose the third because it has the fewest numbers. It shows only מט"ח, under a heading that says "למט"ח". The first one puts "מניות עד 120%" and "מט"ח עד 120%" on every row, and that frightened me. How can a fund be more than all the money?
- The second one puts it in a long line under each fund, "פרופיל 4A: מניות עד 120%, מט"ח עד 10%". I lose a line like that halfway through, and "4A" means nothing to me.
- Even so, I wouldn't put money in any of these. The heading at the top is "קרנות סל", not deposits or saving. On my own I'd have left after that first line.

**What I looked at**
- On each screen I read the fund names: "ת"א 125", "ת"א 90", and two in English letters, S, P, 500 and M, S, C, I something. I skipped those two.
- Then the "עוקבת אחרי מדד ..." part. To me מדד is the price index from the news, so I don't really know what they "follow".
- Then the fees column, "דמי ניהול לפי הדוח של הקרן". Each fund has three lines: "קבועים", "משתנים", "נאמן". I didn't add them up. The ת"א 90 looked cheapest, 0.1%. The two English ones say 0.8%, which looked expensive.
- The small tags: "מחזיקה את המניות", "עסקת החלף", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע". The tax tag worried me.

**What I didn't understand**
- נאמן, עסקת החלף, חשיפה מרבית, מט"ח, 4A and 4D, פרופיל, and "לא מחלקות" in the line at the bottom.
- "בדף הקרן במאיה": I don't know what מאיה is, so I didn't press it.
- The underlined numbers. Do I press them? I don't know.

**What was hard to read**
- Dark background. The column headings and the line under the title are grey and small, and I had trouble even with the screen enlarged.
- The second line at the bottom, about "החשיפה המרבית... לא מה שהיא מחזיקה היום", I read only halfway.

**Where I got tired or worried**
- The rows are busy, with three percentages in each, and after the second screen everything looked the same to me.
- Like I said, I'd have closed the page after the heading.
